description: This file contains classes, enums, and functions to support pairing alert UI and logic for macOS; including alert presentation, user decision handling, and background task management related to pairing process.

classes.name: PairingAlertHostWindow
classes.description: A custom NSWindow subclass that can become key and main, used as a host for pairing alerts.

classes.name: PairingAlertState
classes.description: A class to maintain the current pairing alert, request ID, and alert host window state.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the currently active alert and resets related request ID.

methods.name: requireAlertHostWindow
methods.description: Ensures a window exists to host an alert, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: configureDefaultPairingAlert
methods.description: Configures an NSAlert with default pairing options and styling.

methods.name: beginCenteredSheet
methods.description: Presents an alert as a centered sheet on the host window.

methods.name: runPairingPushTask
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a background task to manage push notifications for pairing.

methods.name: startPairingPushTask
methods.description: Starts a background task for push notification handling if not already running.

methods.name: beginPairingAlert
methods.description: Creates and displays a pairing alert modally centered on the host window.

methods.name: presentPairingAlert
methods.description: Displays a pairing alert and updates current alert/state info.

methods.name: clearActivePairingAlert
methods.description: Clears the current alert and request ID, and hides the alert window.

methods.name: stopPairingPrompter
methods.description: Stops the pairing alert process, cancelling tasks, clearing state, and closing windows.

methods.name: approveRequest
methods.description: Performs an approval action asynchronously, logging success or failure.

methods.name: rejectRequest
methods.description: Performs a rejection action asynchronously, logging success or failure.
